title: Repair a bug from the CLI

scenes.title: Repair an invoice bug without changing the tests
scenes.caption: The deliverable is changed source code. The same original tests must fail before the repair and pass afterward.
scenes.label: A DEVELOPER WORKFLOW / SYNTHETIC TASK

steps.title: A failing calculation
steps.detail: Discounts are ignored. Four existing tests define correct rounding and shipping behavior.

steps.title: An agent repair
steps.detail: OpenCode reads the task, edits the implementation and runs the Node test suite.

steps.title: Independent acceptance
steps.detail: Rerun the original tests. Compare the test hash and inspect the implementation diff.

scenes.title: Your terminal controls a remote workspace
scenes.caption: There is no Kubernetes exec, host repository mount, or paid provider key in this recording.
scenes.label: A DEVELOPER WORKFLOW / SYNTHETIC TASK

steps.title: Your terminal
steps.detail: Published Harakiri CLI. Holds your API key and sends files and commands through the control plane.

steps.title: Remote sandbox
steps.detail: OpenCode, Node and Git work in /workspace. No local project mount or Kubernetes exec.

steps.title: External model
steps.detail: OpenCode calls the explicit free provider. Only synthetic source and tests are used.

scenes.title: Install the CLI and choose the runtime
scenes.caption: The opencode template is ready. Installation is local; OpenCode is already installed in the remote template.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
npm install -g @h-sandbox/cli@0.4.0
harakiri login --api-url "$HARAKIRI_API_URL"
harakiri template list

scenes.title: Create and retain the sandbox ID
scenes.caption: Retain the sandbox ID and confirm running before continuing. TTL is a fallback, not the cleanup step.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
SBX=$(harakiri create --template opencode \
  --name invoice-repair --ttl 600 | sed -n "/^sbx_/p")
test -n "$SBX" || exit 1
trap 'harakiri kill "$SBX"' EXIT
harakiri inspect "$SBX"

scenes.title: Upload the broken source and original tests
scenes.caption: Only source and tests are uploaded. No completed fix is supplied to the agent.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
for file in invoice.mjs invoice.spec.mjs; do
  harakiri file-upload "$SBX" --from "$file" \
    --path "/workspace/$file" --parents
done
harakiri run "$SBX" --cwd /workspace \
  --cmd "git init -q && git add invoice.mjs invoice.spec.mjs"

scenes.title: Configure the main and auxiliary free models
scenes.caption: Both models are explicit. No paid fallback. Free-provider data policies still apply to the uploaded task.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL

scenes.title: Establish the failure before asking for a fix
scenes.caption: Recorded baseline: four tests, one pass, three failures. The test SHA-256 must remain unchanged after the repair.
scenes.label: RECORDED NODE TEST OUTPUT / EXCERPT
scenes.content:
not ok 1 - applies discount before shipping
not ok 2 - rounds discounted cents once
ok 3 - handles no discount
not ok 4 - a full discount still charges shipping
# tests 4
# pass 1
# fail 3

scenes.title: Give OpenCode the complete repair contract
scenes.caption: Discount subtotal, round cents, add shipping unchanged. The agent must edit and test, not merely propose a fix.
scenes.label: cli-prompt.txt / COMPLETE PROMPT
scenes.content: Fix invoice.mjs so subtotal is discounted by discountPercent, rounded to integer cents, then shipping is added unchanged. Run node --test invoice.spec.mjs to verify your fix. Do not modify invoice.spec.mjs. Use your tools to edit and run tests, not just describe a fix.

scenes.title: Start the agent as a tracked command
scenes.caption: Retain the command ID. The 240-second limit bounds execution; the next command waits for its result.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
MODEL=opencode/mimo-v2.5-free
PROMPT=$(cat cli-prompt.txt)
JOB=$(harakiri command run "$SBX" --cwd /workspace \
  --cmd "opencode run --format json --model $MODEL '$PROMPT'" \
  --timeout-ms 240000 --detached --json | jq -r .command.id)
test -n "$JOB" && test "$JOB" != null

scenes.title: Wait and inspect real tool activity
scenes.caption: Completed tools and zero-cost model steps must exist. A successful process alone does not establish a correct repair.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
harakiri command wait "$SBX" "$JOB" \
  --timeout-ms 260000 --json
harakiri command logs "$SBX" "$JOB" --json

scenes.title: Review the actual agent work
scenes.caption: Real read, edit and bash calls completed. The model did not receive a prewritten replacement implementation.
scenes.label: RECORDED COMPLETED TOOLS / COMMAND EXCERPTS
scenes.content:
read     /workspace/invoice.mjs
read     /workspace/invoice.spec.mjs
edit     /workspace/invoice.mjs
bash     node --test invoice.spec.mjs

scenes.title: Rerun the unchanged acceptance tests
scenes.caption: Four tests pass, zero fail, and the original test hash matches. Review the diff before adopting the code.
scenes.label: RECORDED NODE TEST OUTPUT / EXCERPT
scenes.content:
ok 1 - applies discount before shipping
ok 2 - rounds discounted cents once
ok 3 - handles no discount
ok 4 - a full discount still charges shipping
# tests 4
# pass 4
# fail 0

scenes.title: The repair passes the original contract
scenes.caption: Independent test run: 4 passed, 0 failed. Test file unchanged. Completed model steps reported zero cost.
scenes.label: RECORDED REPAIR / INDEPENDENT ASSERTIONS
scenes.content:
Before       1 passed / 3 failed
After        4 passed / 0 failed
Test SHA     unchanged
Model steps  zero reported cost

scenes.title: Retrieve useful work, then terminate
scenes.caption: The recorded sandbox is terminated. Provider failure, timeout or a bad repair still requires cleanup.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
harakiri kill "$SBX"
harakiri inspect "$SBX"
# Only after terminated is confirmed:
trap - EXIT
